recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted clarification in active core source without changing unrelated MedicinalProductDefinition narrative or element definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-31724 was a Published/Persuasive BRR clarification for R5 asking that MedicinalProductDefinition be defined by what it is, rather than primarily by non-direct-patient-care use cases. The accepted Jira comment wording defines a medicinal product and states that this resource defines and details such products and their properties.
